info.title: Agentic APIOps Demo Order Service API

put.description: Transitions an enabled user to DISABLED. Repeating the request for an already disabled user is idempotent.

409.description: User is in an unexpected state for disabling.

value.message: user id 1 is in unexpected status, disable failed

put.description: Transitions an ON_SALE product to OFF_SALE. Repeating the request for an already off-sale product is idempotent.

409.description: Product status cannot be transitioned to OFF_SALE.

value.message: product id 1 is in unexpected status, off-shelf failed

post.description: Creates an enabled user from a stable user business number and display name.

requestBody.description: Stable user number and display name.

409.description: The user business number already exists.

value.message: user with userNo usr_001 already exists

post.description: Creates a user-coupon instance for an enabled user and an active, currently valid coupon template.

400.description: User or coupon id is invalid.

404.description: User or coupon template does not exist.

409.description: The user is ineligible, the template is inactive/out of validity, or the user already claimed it.

get.description: Returns a page of products using the optional exact/contains filters.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Optional status filter. The service applies it as an exact persisted-status filter.

schema.description: Optional status filter. The service applies it as an exact persisted-status filter.

400.description: Page or filter parameter validation failed.

post.description: Creates a catalog product. When status is omitted, the service stores ON_SALE.

requestBody.description: Product business number, name, price, and optional initial status.

value.message: product with productNo prd_001 already exists

post.description: Processes a SUCCESS callback, transitions the pending payment and order, and returns FIRST_SUCCESS or IDEMPOTENT_REPLAY for duplicate delivery.

requestBody.description: Payment platform callback payload. callbackId is the idempotency key.

404.description: Referenced payment or order does not exist.

409.description: Payment/order identity, amount, status, result, or callback idempotency conflicts.

post.description: Creates an order in PENDING_PAYMENT state, deducts inventory, optionally consumes the user's available coupon, and creates the pending payment record.

requestBody.description: Order owner, distinct product lines, and an optional coupon template id.

400.description: Request body or parameter validation failed.

404.description: Referenced user, product, or coupon template does not exist.

409.description: Order creation conflicts with product status, inventory, duplicate lines, or coupon availability.

post.description: Applies the fixed CANCEL event and returns the resulting order details.

200.description: Order cancelled or already in the resulting state.

409.description: Order state cannot transition to CANCELLED.

post.description: Fault-injection endpoint enabled only in local/test profiles; the endpoint itself is public and deliberately returns the service's 401 token-expired error envelope.

get.description: Returns the user's claimed coupon instances, optionally filtered by AVAILABLE, USED, or EXPIRED status.

400.description: User id or status filter is invalid.

get.description: Returns one user view by primary key.
Returns one product catalog view by primary key.
Returns one order with its persisted item snapshots.
Returns one coupon template by its primary key.

400.description: Coupon id must be at least 1.

get.description: Fault-injection endpoint enabled only in local/test profiles. delayMs defaults to 500 and must be between 100 and 2000 inclusive.

parameters.name: delayMs
parameters.description: Requested SQL delay in milliseconds; defaults to 500.

400.description: delayMs is outside the 100-2000 inclusive range.

500.description: Unexpected server or fault infrastructure failure.

createdAt.description: Creation time in ISO-8601 date-time format.

updatedAt.description: Last update time in ISO-8601 date-time format.

UserVO.description: User view. Authentication credentials and persistence-only fields are not exposed.

data.description: Endpoint-specific response data. It is null for error responses.

ApiResponse.description: Common response envelope used by every demo-order-service HTTP endpoint.

price.description: Sale price in the service's monetary unit.

createdAt.description: Creation time in ISO-8601 date-time format.

updatedAt.description: Last update time in ISO-8601 date-time format.

ProductVO.description: Product catalog view. Persistence-only fields such as version and deleted are not exposed.

CreateUserRequest.description: Request to create a demo user.

thresholdAmount.description: Minimum order amount required by the coupon template.

discountAmount.description: Discount amount granted by the coupon template.

validFrom.description: Coupon validity start in ISO-8601 date-time format.

validUntil.description: Coupon validity end in ISO-8601 date-time format.

createdAt.description: Creation time in ISO-8601 date-time format.

updatedAt.description: Last update time in ISO-8601 date-time format.

CouponVO.description: Coupon template view. The id identifies a coupon template, not a user-owned coupon instance.

userId.description: User primary key that owns the coupon.

couponId.description: Coupon template primary key from demo_coupon; this is not the user-coupon instance id.

receivedAt.description: Time when the user claimed the coupon.

usedAt.description: Time when the user-coupon was consumed; null while unused.

createdAt.description: Creation time in ISO-8601 date-time format.

updatedAt.description: Last update time in ISO-8601 date-time format.

UserCouponVO.description: User-owned coupon view. couponId refers to the coupon template primary key.

price.description: Sale price in the service's monetary unit.

status.description: Initial product status. Omit it to use ON_SALE.

CreateProductRequest.description: Request to create a product in the catalog.

callbackId.description: Payment platform callback identifier used for idempotency.

orderId.description: Order primary key associated with the payment.

paymentAmount.description: Amount reported by the payment platform; it must equal the payment amount.

result.description: Payment result. Only SUCCESS is accepted for this callback endpoint; another non-blank value is a business conflict.

callbackTime.description: Optional time supplied by the payment platform; omitted values use server receipt time.

PaymentCallbackRequest.description: Stable business fields received from the payment platform callback.

orderId.description: Order primary key associated with the payment.

paymentAmount.description: Payment amount accepted by the callback processor.

replay.description: Whether this request replayed an already processed callback.

PaymentCallbackResultVO.description: Result of a payment callback, including whether it was a first delivery or an idempotent replay.

CreateOrderItemRequest.description: One product line in an order creation request.

userId.description: User primary key that owns the order.

items.description: At least one distinct product line.

couponId.description: Coupon template primary key from demo_coupon; the service resolves the user's AVAILABLE user-coupon record before consuming it.

CreateOrderRequest.description: Request to create an order for one user.

userId.description: User primary key that owns the order.

originalAmount.description: Sum of order-item line amounts before coupon discount.

discountAmount.description: Coupon discount applied to the order.

createdAt.description: Creation time in ISO-8601 date-time format.

updatedAt.description: Last update time in ISO-8601 date-time format.

items.description: Order lines in ascending item-id order.

OrderDetailVO.description: Full order details returned by order lifecycle operations.

productNo.description: Product business number captured at order creation.

productName.description: Product name captured at order creation.

unitPrice.description: Unit sale price captured at order creation.

quantity.description: Number of units in this line.

OrderItemVO.description: Order line snapshot returned with order details.

pageNo.description: 1-based page number returned by the service.

pageSize.description: Page size returned by the service.

ProductPageVO.description: Page response for product catalog queries.
